query: Equinix AFFO guidance FY 2026 and per-share diluted AFFO figure
normalized: 2026 affo diluted equinix figure fy guidance per share

output.content:
Equinix’s latest FY2026 guidance is **AFFO of $4.240–$4.300 billion**. [[1]] 

Its corresponding **diluted AFFO per share guidance is $42.69–$43.29**. [[1]] 

Equinix stated that all per-share amounts are presented on a fully diluted basis. [[1]]

sources.title: Equinix Reports Second-Quarter Results, Raises 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Outlook :: Equinix, Inc. (EQIX)
